# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (Jan 29, 2026)
## OVERVIEW
Today's development focused on improving RPC handling by adding a new feature and fixing several broken public endpoints. Additionally, new pull requests were opened to add token addresses for Celo and RNBW.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### RPC Endpoint Management and Reliability
Significant effort was put into refining RPC handling, including a new feature to improve overall RPC management ([#1262](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1262)). Several public RPC endpoints that were no longer active and causing flakiness were removed, enhancing the stability of the system. This includes the removal of `https://rpc.ankr.com/eth` ([#1263](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1263)), `https://base.llamarpc.com` and `https://eth.llamarpc.com` ([#1261](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1261)), and `https://optimism.llamarpc.com` ([#1259](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1259)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **RNBW Token Integration**: A new pull request ([#1264](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1264)) has been opened to integrate the RNBW token.
- **Celo Network Token Addresses**: A feature request ([#1260](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1260)) was opened to add Celo network addresses for weETH and wstETH tokens.
- **OLAS Token for Celo**: A pull request ([#1258](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1258)) was opened to add the OLAS token to the Celo network.

## CLOSED ISSUES
- **CCI Stats Cronjob Failures Resolved**: The issue regarding CCI Stats Cronjob Failures ([#542](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/542)) has been closed. The fix involved generating a new docker image and releasing the digest. Subsequent job runs were successful with no "not found" errors.

## NEW ISSUES
- **Historical Proofs Migration**: A new issue ([#18984](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18984)) was opened to migrate historical proofs support code from `op-rs/op-reth` into `op-reth`, with a note on maintaining the code in stable and unstable branches due to cyclic dependencies.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
- **op-reth Snapshots for Verifiers/Node Operators**: Issue [#18473](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18473) discusses adding op-reth snapshots to `https://datadirs.optimism.io` for verifiers and node operators using Reth. The latest comment from sebastianst suggests that this task might already be completed.
